column1: # The write matrix: writer, path, grant, how. Tab-separated.
# grant rw: a directory the writer creates, renames and unlinks files in. It is
#           exactly the writer's unit's ReadWritePaths= set, and the DAC in
#           tree.tsv gives the same writer the same directory (and nobody else,
#           except the shared halts/ where the sticky bit and file ownership
# grant ro: a directory inside one of the writer's rw directories that another
#           writer owns; the unit remasks it read-only (ReadOnlyPaths=) so the
#           namespace grant is exact, not just the DAC. It is exactly the
#           unit's ReadOnlyPaths= set minus the tree root.
# The heartbeat/ under a rw directory is inside that grant and is not listed.
# check-units.sh --static asserts every unit against this file.
# gtobs-tunnel: own store; author of admin/copy; copy-tunnel in super; slot tunnel in the other three halts/

column4: own store: heartbeat/<seq>.hb(.tmp), fault(.tmp), halt(.tmp); DAC group bit on a root-owned sticky root
tunnel is admin's copy author (copy-authors admin=tunnel); DAC owner
tunnel's copy in the coordinator's store; DAC owner
slot halts/tunnel only; DAC group gtring-halts-admin + sticky
slot halts/tunnel only; DAC group gtring-halts-material + sticky
slot halts/tunnel only; DAC group gtring-halts-super + sticky
material's copy inside tunnel's store; owned gtobs-material
super's copy inside tunnel's store; owned gtobs-super
halts delivered to tunnel; written by the other three, never by tunnel
